ideas.pitch: A rapid multi-language symptom triage and rPPG vital signs estimator for primary care waiting rooms.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges in the healthcare sector: patient bottleneck and initial symptom prioritisation.
ideas.title: AuraTriage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner architecture with live camera rPPG sensing and bilingual clinical triage that judges can immediately test on their own webcams.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI system that audits hospital insurance pre-authorizations for hidden algorithmic bias and denial patterns.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges in the healthcare sector: administrative burden and fairness in health insurance approvals.
ideas.title: MedClaimAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent workflow architecture which judges love for technical depth and solves a massive economic pain point for clinics.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical interview simulator that tests medical students against a 6-dimension communication rubric.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges in the healthcare sector: medical training scalability and clinician assessment.
ideas.title: OSCE-Sim
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into the winning formula of educational AI simulation tools that have proven highly successful at previous hackathons by targeting a clear institutional niche.

ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first multilingual AI companion for rural health workers to deliver preventive care and track vaccination schedules.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges in the healthcare sector: last-mile health education and preventive care tracking in rural populations.
ideas.title: GraminSwasthya
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts a first-prize winning rural health concept into an accessible voice interface optimized for regional impact and social feasibility.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision rehabilitation assistant that tracks joint angles in real-time to score physical therapy compliance at home.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges in the healthcare sector: patient adherence to post-operative physical therapy regimens.
ideas.title: PosturePulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a live, interactive webcam demonstration that works instantly during judging without requiring specialized wearable hardware.
